title: 第1章 一人一刀一只鸟
content_zh:
第1章一人一刀一只鸟
大魏，云安城。
初夏的阵雨，便如同夜闯深闺的采花小贼，来时风急雨骤，去时行色匆匆，只留下沟壑间的泥泞水渍，和那一树带雨梨花。
风停雨住，京城街头逐渐活跃，百姓陆续走出家门，贩夫走卒沿街叫卖：
“包子——”
“卖煤咯……”
满街嘈杂声中，一支车队从天水桥的街口缓缓驶来。
马车在后，前方是十三骑押车武人，皆身披蓑衣头戴斗笠，腰后横刀，风尘仆仆。
京师重地，江湖气这么浓的队伍着实罕见，不少行人侧目打量，却见车队为首的是一名年轻男子。
男子蓑衣下穿着黑袍，肩膀上站着一只大白鸟，身材高大、皮肤白净，双眸乌黑泛着明亮色泽，一双剑眉，更是俊气脸庞多了三分凌厉。
“哇——娘，快看，那个哥哥长得好俊！”
“嘘~别乱喊，羞不羞？”
“那只鸟好胖~”
“叽？”
“嘿？还能听懂人话！”
街上少妇少女的赞誉，黑衣年轻人恍若未闻，目不斜视带着队伍，来到街尾的镇远镖局外。
整个天水桥的商铺，都挂着‘裴’字家徽，镇远镖局亦是如此。
能在寸土寸金的京城买下一条街的人家，显然不是小门小户，派头十足，镖局黄木青瓦的高大门头外，时常站着两个撑门面的镖师。
瞧见不认识的马队到了门前，一名镖师上前拱手，行了个江湖礼：
“阁下是？”

“夜惊堂。”
镖师面露茫然，扫了眼一众气势不俗的武人：
“未曾听过阁下大名。阁下是来运镖，还是……”
“踢馆。”
“……”
此言出，街面一静。
本来闲逛的路人，全都围了过来，连街边卖馄饨的小贩，都放下汤勺，手在围裙上抹了抹，踮起脚尖打量：
“怎么回事？”
“踢馆的，这场面在京城着实少见……”
镖局外的两名镖师，见黑衣年轻人来者不善，脸色皆沉。
换成寻常愣头青，应该出言喝退，但门外十三骑，个个带刀，架势和灭门似的，不太好惹，镖师神色还是比较客气，拱手道：
“京师重地，严禁私斗。我们东家是正经生意人，遵纪守法，踢馆的事儿接不了，阁下若是和东家纠纷，可以去击鸣冤鼓，咱们去衙门说理……”
此言出，围观群众当即开始喝倒彩：
“咦……”
“还习武的，人家都打上门了，你让人去报官像话吗？”
“对呀……”
黑衣年轻人自腰后解下佩刀，丢给背后一人，赤手空拳道：
“让你们镖头出来，打一场我就走。”
眼见街坊全围了过来，镖师面露不悦，旁边一人往街边跑去，看模样想报官。
可惜，刚跑出几步，就被黑衣年轻人背后的刀客拦住了去路。

“嘿！你……”
此举一出，镖局大门后就冲出七八人，手提刀枪，脸色震怒。
镖局内部，也传来一道中气十足的嗓音：
“小子，年轻气盛可以，但眼睛得擦亮点……”
众人转眼看去，却见镖局大院的正房里走出一人，穿着一袭锦袍，身材魁梧，满是老茧的右手，转着两枚铁核桃。
咔咔……
门外的镖师见状，连忙开口呼唤：
“陈爷，这小子闹事。”
围观的街坊，眼热起来，七嘴八舌说着：
“陈彪都出来了。”
“这俊哥儿不会被打死吧？”
“京城哪敢出人命，最多打吐血。”
“这么俊，打吐血也心疼呀……”
众人还没说两句，忽听街面传来一声破风轻响。
诸多镖师和行人，只觉眼前一花，原本坐在马上的黑衣年轻人，不知如何发力，便冲天而起，自镖局丈余高的门头上方跃过，砸入镖局大院。
刚从屋里走出来的陈彪，被此景惊得一哆嗦，本能丢出两枚铁核桃，却被黑袍年轻人一袖扫开，继而就是苍鹰扑兔，一爪扣在了他脖子上。
眨眼间，人高马大的陈彪，就被摁在了背后的门柱上，撞掉了屋檐上的几片黑瓦。
啪嗒——
瓦片掉在地上摔了个粉碎，也惊的院内十余名镖师一个抖，眼神惊悚。
陈彪骇的面无人色，连反抗的意思都没有，急声高呼：

“少侠且慢！我就是个镖头，你有仇找东家去，别冲我来啊……”
能说出话来，显然就没下死手。
黑袍年轻人单手抓住陈彪的脖子，偏头示意门外的一个老刀客：
“他叫杨朝，以后他是镖头，你是老二，明白吗？”
陈彪莫名其妙，但被掐着脖子也不敢还嘴，只是摊开手道：
“少侠，我们这是按时交商税的正规行当，不是江湖码头。东家不同意，你把我打死我也做不了主呀……”
“家父裴远峰，你们东家的胞弟，让我把家中产业给你们送来。今后他们就是镇远镖局的人，若有亏待，唯你试问。”
陈彪一愣，打量黑衣年轻人几眼，惊疑道：
“你是二爷的儿子？！你怎么姓夜？”
夜惊堂并未回答，说完话后，取出一叠百两面额的官票，拍在陈彪胸口，转身离去。
门外，街坊邻居都看愣了，交头接耳轻声嘀咕：
“好俊的身手……”
“这是裴家的少爷？”
“听起来是……以前裴家是有个老二，二三十年前的事儿了……”
跟随而来的十二骑镖师，表情都很复杂，为首的杨镖头，把刀递给走出门的夜惊堂，劝道：
“少东家，你何必如此？老东家爱说酒话，你不用当真，你这净身出户，能去哪儿啊？”
“江湖。”
夜惊堂接过佩刀放回腰间，让宠物鸟停在肩膀上，看向天边的朝阳，轻轻吸了口气。
身形看似洒脱，但那双澄澈眸子里，却闪过了一抹‘天地虽大，却无一处可安身’的迷茫。
来到这个名为‘大魏’的朝代，已经十八年。

两三岁时记忆逐渐苏醒，夜惊堂便生活在大魏边关小镇的一家镖局内，是东家裴远峰走镖途中捡来的弃儿，因为他嗓门大哭声响亮，给他取名‘夜惊堂’，收为了义子。
裴远峰年轻时打架受了伤，终生未娶、无儿无女，对他这义子的成长十分‘关怀’——一天揍三顿、逢年过节加倍——硬是把奢望靠‘抄诗酿酒造肥皂’扬名的夜惊堂，揍成了镖局的金牌打手。
就在上个月，裴远峰酗酒成性，一场大醉后，死在了酒桌上。
夜惊堂料理后事，在裴远峰的遗物中，发现了一封信。
信是为防不测提前写的，上面只说了三件事：
一：裴远峰并非寻常人，曾经是赫赫有名的江湖高手。本想等他成年看清楚品性，再教他‘绝世刀法’，但他能看到信，就说明他没这个福气了。彼此父子一场，他得自己想办法练刀，去找当年打伤裴远峰的人寻仇。
裴远峰人都没了，是不是真高手，已经不重要。子报父仇天经地义，夜惊堂对此并无异议。
可能是怕他没地方学高深武艺，裴远峰还告诉了他一件秘闻，也就是第二件事——前朝灭国时，裴远峰的师父趁乱摸入皇宫，偷到了《鸣龙图》残卷。
传言《鸣龙图》乃无上秘籍，记载九种奇门秘术，得其一便能力压常人，全学会可长生不老、羽化登仙。
但当时厮杀太惨烈，没带出皇宫，就地埋在‘后宫’一颗银杏树下，裴远峰让他若有机会，务必进宫取之。
夜惊堂当时看到这里，相当无语。
从描述来看，《鸣龙图》应该是他盼了十八年的‘外挂、金手指’。
这种独一无二的人间至宝，他自然想要，但埋在皇城‘后宫’，让他一个大老爷们去取，他自宫当太监混进去不成？
欲练此功，必先自宫？
这事儿等于没说，对夜惊堂影响最大的，是最后一件事：
裴远峰少小离家至死未归，觉得亏欠父母，让他把镖局产业变卖，给远在京城的裴家送去，没说给他留一分钱。
夜惊堂若不是看见书信，都不知道孤苦伶仃的义父，还有一房兄弟。
好歹父子一场，他未曾尽孝，也在家里忙活这么多年，直接让他净身出户，把家业给亲戚，着实有点没把他当儿子看。
换做寻常人，肯定不搭理这封信，反正没外人知道。
但夜惊堂不一样，上辈子早已成为过去，在这个世界，他只有一个亲人，彼此毫无血缘，能把他捡回来抚养成人，已经是对他仁至义尽，他甚至没来得及报答尽孝。

夜惊堂最终还是遵从遗嘱，卖掉了边关小城的镖局，换了一千两银子，带着十二个愿意走的镖师及其家眷，千里迢迢来到了大魏京城。
夜惊堂七尺男儿，不可能寄人篱下。
如今安顿好义父手下的老人，家产交给裴家，夜惊堂就彻底和过往告别，成了无依无靠随遇而安的江湖浪子。
身前不知来路，往后不知归途，只剩一人一鸟一把刀。说去‘江湖’，可站在街口茫然四顾，哪里是‘江湖’
夜惊堂手牵黑马，穿过熙熙攘攘的人群，沿着街道行走，漫无目的，有些失神。
但刚走出不过几步，身旁忽然传来两声脆响。
“当当——”
一根撑起推窗的支杆，从二楼坠落，滚到了脚边。
抬眼看向二楼窗口，却见一道千娇百媚的风韵倩影，落入了眼帘……

Chapter 1 One person, one knife, one bird
Great Wei, Yun'an City.
Showers in early summer are like little flower-picking thieves who wander into the boudoir at night. They come in strong winds and rain, and then leave in a hurry, leaving only muddy water stains in the ravines and the pear tree carrying the rain.
The wind stopped and the rain subsided, and the streets of the capital became increasingly lively. People began to walk out of their homes, and vendors and goons hawked along the streets:
"Baozi——"
"Selling coal..."
Amidst the noise in the street, a motorcade slowly drove from the intersection of Tianshui Bridge.
The carriage is behind, and in front are thirteen warriors riding and escorting the carriage. They are all wearing raincoats and bamboo hats, with swords across their waists, and are dusty from the world.
In the important place of the capital, it is rare for a team to have such a strong atmosphere. Many pedestrians looked sideways, but they saw that the leader of the team was a young man.
The man was wearing a black robe under his raincoat, with a big white bird standing on his shoulder. He was tall, with fair skin, dark eyes and bright eyes, and a pair of sword-shaped eyebrows, which made his handsome face even more sharp.
"Wow - Mom, look, that brother is so handsome!"
"Shh~ don't yell, are you ashamed?"
"That bird is so fat~"
"Ji?"
"Hey? I can still understand people!"
The young man in black seemed not to have heard the compliments of the young women and girls on the street, and led the team to the Zhenyuan Escort Bureau at the end of the street without squinting.
The entire shop in Tianshuiqiao has the family emblem with the word 'Pei' hanging on it, as does the Zhenyuan Escort Agency.
Those who can afford to buy a street in the capital, where every inch of land is at a premium, are obviously not from a small family and are full of style. Outside the tall yellow wood and green tiled gate of the escort agency, there are often two escorts standing in front of them to support the facade.
Seeing the unknown cavalry arrive in front of the door, an escort stepped forward and held his hands, making a quaint salute:
"Your Excellency?"
"Night Terror Hall."
The bodyguard looked confused and glanced at the group of powerful warriors:
"I have never heard of your name. Are you here to transport escorts, or..."
"Kick the gym."
"..."
After saying this, the street became quiet.
All the passers-by who were wandering around gathered around, and even the wonton vendor on the street put down their spoons, wiped their hands on their aprons, and stood on tiptoes to look at:
"What's going on?"
"Players, this scene is really rare in the capital..."
The two escorts outside the escort office became dark when they saw the unkind young man in black.
If he were an ordinary young man with a stunned look, he should have shouted back, but the thirteen knights outside the door, all with swords, and their postures were as if they were destroying the clan. They were not easy to mess with. The bodyguard still looked polite and said:
"Private fights are strictly prohibited in this important place in the capital. Our boss is a serious businessman and abides by the law. We can't handle the matter of kicking the club. If you have a dispute with your boss, you can go and complain, and we can go to the Yamen to reason..."
After saying this, the onlookers immediately began to boo:
"Eh..."
"People who are still practicing martial arts are knocking on your door. Are you honest about asking someone to report it to the official?"
"Yes..."
The young man in black took off his saber from his waist, threw it to the person behind him, and said with his bare hands:
"Let your escort head come out and I'll leave after one fight."
Seeing that the neighbors were all surrounding him, the bodyguard showed displeasure, and a man next to him ran to the street, hoping to report to the police.
Unfortunately, as soon as he ran a few steps, he was blocked by the swordsman behind the young man in black.
"Hey! You..."
As soon as this move came out, seven or eight people rushed out from behind the door of the escort agency, holding knives and guns with angry faces.
A powerful voice also came from inside the escort agency:
"Boy, it's okay to be young and energetic, but you need to brighten your eyes..."
Everyone turned around and saw a man walking out of the main room of the escort agency. He was wearing a brocade robe and had a tall build. His right hand, which was full of calluses, was spinning two iron walnuts.
Kaka...
The escort outside the door saw this and quickly called:
"Master Chen, this kid is making trouble."
The onlookers' eyes grew hot and they talked a lot:
"Chen Biao is out."
"This handsome guy won't be beaten to death, right?"
"How dare anyone die in the capital? The most they can do is vomit blood."
"So handsome, I'll vomit bloodI feel bad too..."
Before anyone could say a word, they suddenly heard a soft sound of breaking wind coming from the street.
Many escorts and passers-by felt their eyes dazzled when the young man in black who was sitting on the horse, not knowing how to use his strength, rose into the sky, jumped over the door of the escort office which was more than ten feet high, and smashed into the courtyard of the escort office.
Chen Biao, who had just walked out of the house, was startled by this scene. He instinctively threw two iron walnuts, but they were swept away by the young man in black robes with his sleeve. Then the goshawk pounced on the rabbit and clasped its claws on his neck.
In the blink of an eye, the tall Chen Biao was pressed against the doorpost behind him, knocking off several black tiles on the eaves.
snap——
The tiles fell to the ground and shattered into pieces, which shocked the more than ten escorts in the courtyard to tremble, with horrified eyes.
Chen Biaohai's face was pale and he didn't even have the intention to resist. He shouted urgently:
"Young hero, wait a minute! I'm just a bodyguard. If you have a grudge against my employer, don't come at me..."
If you can speak out, it's obvious that you won't kill him.
The young man in black robe grabbed Chen Biao's neck with one hand and tilted his head to signal an old swordsman outside the door:
"His name is Yang Chao. From now on, he will be the head guard and you will be the second in command. Do you understand? "
Chen Biao was confused, but he didn't dare to talk back when his neck was being pinched. He just spread his hands and said:
"Young hero, we are a formal business that pays business taxes on time, not a Jianghu wharf. If my boss doesn’t agree, I can’t make the decision even if you beat me to death..."
"My father, Pei Yuanfeng, your boss's brother, asked me to bring you my family's property. From now on, they will be members of the Zhenyuan Escort Bureau. If they are treated badly, you can ask. "
Chen Biao was stunned, looked at the young man in black, and said in surprise:
"Are you the second master's son? ! What's your surname Ye? "
Ye Jingtang did not answer. After speaking, he took out a stack of official tickets with a denomination of one hundred taels, patted Chen Biao's chest, turned and left.
Outside the door, the neighbors were stunned and whispered to each other:
"What a handsome skill..."
"Is this the young master of the Pei family? "
"It sounds like... there used to be a second child in the Pei family, twenty or thirty years ago..."
The twelve cavalry escorts who followed had complicated expressions. The leader, Mr. Yang, handed the knife to Ye Jingtang who walked out of the door and advised:
"Young master, why are you doing this? My old boss likes to talk while drinking, so you don’t need to take it seriously. Where can you go when you leave home? "
“Jianghu. "
Ye Jingtang took the sword and put it back on his waist, let the pet bird rest on his shoulder, looked at the rising sun on the horizon, and took a gentle breath.
The figure seemed free and easy, but in those clear eyes, there was a flash of confusion that "although the world is huge, there is no place to stay".
It has been eighteen years since I came to this dynasty called 'Da Wei'.
When he was two or three years old, his memory gradually came back to him. Ye Jingtang lived in an escort agency in the border town of Dawei. He was an abandoned child picked up by his boss Pei Yuanfeng on his way to escort. Because he had a loud voice and cried loudly, he was named "Ye Jingtang" and adopted as his adopted son.
Pei Yuanfeng was injured in a fight when he was young. He never married and had no children. He was very 'concerned' about his adopted son's growth - he beat him three times a day, twice as much on New Years and holidays - and he just beat Ye Jingtang, who had hoped to become famous by copying poems and wine to make soap, and turned him into a gold medal thug in the escort agency.
Just last month, Pei Yuanfeng was addicted to alcohol. After a heavy drunkenness, he died on the wine table.
Ye Jingtang was taking care of the funeral and found a letter among Pei Yuanfeng's belongings.
The letter was written in advance to prepare for the unexpected, and it only said three things:
1: Pei Yuanfeng is not an ordinary person. He was once a famous martial artist. I originally wanted to wait until he reaches adulthood to see his character clearly, and then teach him the 'peerless sword skills', but the fact that he can see the letter means that he is not so lucky. In a fight between father and son, he had to find a way to practice swordsmanship on his own and seek revenge on the person who injured Pei Yuanfeng.
Pei Yuanfeng's people are all gone. Whether he is a real master or not is no longer important. It is natural for a son to avenge his father, and Ye Jingtang has no objection to this.
Maybe it's because he's afraid that he won't have anywhere to learn advanced martial arts.Pei Yuanfeng also told him a secret, which was the second thing - when the previous dynasty was destroyed, Pei Yuanfeng's master took advantage of the chaos and sneaked into the palace and stole the fragments of "The Singing Dragon Picture".
It is rumored that "The Picture of the Singing Dragon" is a supreme secret book, which records nine kinds of strange secret arts. If you get one of them, you will be more powerful than ordinary people, and if you learn it, you can live forever and become immortal.
But the fighting was too fierce at that time, so he was not taken out of the palace and buried under a ginkgo tree in the harem. Pei Yuanfeng told him that if he had a chance, he must enter the palace to get it.
When Ye Jingtang saw this, he was quite speechless.
Judging from the description, "Crying Dragon Picture" should be the "plug-in, golden finger" that he has been looking forward to for eighteen years.
He naturally wants this unique treasure in the world, but if it is buried in the "harem" of the imperial city and he, a great man, is asked to retrieve it, can he sneak in by working as a eunuch in the palace?
If you want to practice this skill, you must first retreat from the palace?
This matter has not been mentioned. The biggest impact on Night Terror Hall is the last thing:
Pei Yuanfeng left home when he was young and never returned. Feeling that he owed his parents, they asked him to sell the escort agency property and send it to the Pei family in the capital, without leaving a penny for him.
If Ye Jingtang hadn't seen the letter, he wouldn't have known that his lonely foster father had a brother.
After all, it was a father-son relationship. He had not fulfilled his filial piety and had been busy at home for so many years. He was asked to leave the house and give the family property to his relatives. He really did not regard him as a son.
An ordinary person would definitely ignore this letter, since no one would know.
But Ye Jingtang is different. His previous life has long since passed. In this world, he only has one relative, who is not related to them by blood. To be able to pick him up and raise him as an adult is already the utmost kindness and righteousness to him. He didn't even have time to repay his filial piety.
Ye Jing Tang finally complied with his will and sold the escort bureau in the small border town for a thousand taels of silver. He took twelve willing escorts and their families and came all the way to the capital of Wei.
It is impossible for a seven-foot-tall man in Night Terror Hall to live under someone else's roof.
Now that the old people under his adoptive father have been settled and the property has been handed over to the Pei family, Ye Jingtang has completely said goodbye to the past and has become a helpless prodigal who lives in peace with the situation.
I don't know where I came from, and I don't know where I'm going back. There's only one person, one bird and one knife left. He said he was going to the "jianghu", but when he stood at the street corner and looked around blankly, where was the "jianghu"?
Ye Jingtang held the black horse in hand and walked through the bustling crowd and along the street, aimlessly and a little lost.
But just after taking a few steps, two crisp sounds suddenly came from beside him.
"Dangdang——"
A pole holding up the sliding window fell from the second floor and rolled to his feet.
Looking up to the window on the second floor, I saw a charming and charming figure falling into my eyes...
